title: Amendment No. 3, Contract for Services – Mobile Modular Management Corporation – Madison Park Academy Expansion Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 3, Contract for Services between the District and Mobile Modular Management Corporation, Livermore, CA, for the latter to sell two (2) leased portable classrooms at the jobsite to the District and for a rate increase to cover any outstanding invoices for the current lease, which leads to an amended contract price, as described in the Purchase Off Rent document, dated October 27, 2020, attached as Exhibit A to this Amendment No. 3; District agrees that the purchase of these portable classrooms is subject to all the terms and conditions set forth in Amendment No. 3 and in the event of any conflicts between the terms of the Agreement and Amendment No. 3, the terms of the latter shall supersede and govern, for the Madison Park Academy Expansion Project, in an additional amount of $90,000.00, increasing Agreement not to exceed amount from $320,340.85 to $410,340.85,  for the term June 27, 2019 through December 30, 2020, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Consultant. title: Agreement for General Services – Jensen Hughes – Facilities Planning & Management – B & G Fire Alarm Shop Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement for General Services between the District and Jensen Hughes (“Consultant”), Concord, CA, for the latter to provide following services: a. Meet with District Facilities and Buildings & Grounds Alarm Shop personnel to evaluate the effectiveness of the current Fire and Intrusion Alarm Standards; b. Advise District on the impact of potential changes to the Standards; c. Prepare revisions to the Standards as directed by District. Up to 2 hours for conference call or video meetings are included; d. Develop new requirements for fire alarm and intrusion alarm systems based on input from the District’s Alarm shop. New requirements are anticipated to align with product line changes by Johnson Controls and Bosch Security; District’s selected vendors. Up 16 hours to develop the new requirements are included; e. When requested, develop new Fire and Intrusion Alarm Standards bulletins to address new needs as they emerge. Up to 12 hours are included; f. All work described in the November 2, 2020 proposal attached to this Agreement as Exhibit A, in the not to exceed amount of $8,688.61, as the selected Consultant, with work scheduled to commence on December 10, 2020, and scheduled to last until June 30, 2021, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Agreement for same with said Consultant.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays Jensen Hughes up to $8,688.61 to update the district's fire and intrusion alarm standards
summary: Jensen Hughes, a consulting firm in Concord, will meet with district Facilities and Buildings & Grounds alarm shop staff, review the current fire and intrusion alarm standards, and write revisions and new requirements. The new requirements are expected to match product changes from Johnson Controls and Bosch Security. Work runs from December 10, 2020 to June 30, 2021.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
